title: CS60056: Information Technology In Medicine
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Computers in clinical medicine and practice. Informatics and its relevance to
medicine, cybernetics and virtual reality. Applications of internet technology
and world-wide web in health care delivery, development and spread.
Introduction to data base and knowledge based system. ER models, relational
data model and query languages. Storage, retrieval and management of medical
information â patient medical history, records of physical and systematic
examinations and investigations including signs and systems, tests â laboratory
and pathology, diagnosis and treatment. Decision support systems in medicine â
soft computing techniques in medicine. Interactive applications and medical
information system. Integrated Hospital Information system. Computer aided
learning and education for medical and paramedical professionals.
